svg.title: Beckenburg College door and circulation plan
svg.desc: Measured basement, ground and upper plans with eighteen fitted doors. Dashed circulation guidance follows the van ramp, existing grade and fitted entrances. A strip below shows the continuous verified journeys to maintenance and upper residence.
svg.text: Beckenburg College door and circulation plan
Existing floor datums, fitted openings, and surveyed approaches
New jambs in rebuilt wall bays
Van-to-lobby guidance across actual walking surfaces
Both journeys were walked in both directions, standing and crouched.
